table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_HEADING: Checked on this computer for text and QR codes:
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_TEXT_FOUND: {slot}: the picture shows text ({chars} characters). Read by the computer, not checked:
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_QR_LINK: {slot}: the picture shows a QR code that opens a link on {host}. Anyone who points a phone at your video can open it.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_QR_LINK_UNKNOWN: {slot}: the picture shows a QR code with a link whose address could not be read as a site name.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_QR_ACTION: {slot}: the picture shows a QR code that starts an action on a phone ({scheme}).
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_QR_TEXT: {slot}: the picture shows a QR code holding text, not a link:
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_QR_UNREADABLE: {slot}: something in the picture looks like a QR code that could not be read.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_PARTIAL: {slot}: the scan ran out of time on this clip, so only part of it was checked (QR codes on {value} of {total} frames).
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_FAILED: These pictures were not checked for text or QR codes ({reason}). You can still approve them.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_NOT_RUN: These pictures were not checked for text or QR codes. You can still approve them.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_CLEAN: {slot}: no text or QR code found.
table.CARD_VIDEO_SCAN_SCOPE: English, Portuguese and Spanish text is read; text in other alphabets is not.
